rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: val_n=15, gs_n_gaussians=1024, gs_n_iter=130, gs_lr_pos=0.005, gs_lr_scale=0.01, gs_lr_amp=0.01, gs_lr_rot=0.01, gs_amp_init=0.01, gs_scale_init=0.04, gs_tv_weight=0.0001, gs_n_clip=0.05, gs_init_from_fbp=True, gs_render=raster, gs_ssim_weight=0.3, seed=42, train_n=0, rationale=iter-11 (search-20260703-01) -- CEILING CONFIRMATION #3. SIX-BOX: hr pinned 0 at EVERY prior iter; best SSIM 0.9278 @ iter-6. R2-Gaussian is REGIME-BOUNDED on dense 128-view breast: the coarse anisotropic-Gaussian basis (1024 splats, 0.006M params) plateaus at SSIM ~0.928 / PSNR ~28.7 dB, ~7.3 dB BELOW the 128-view FBP baseline (PSNR 35.97), so the RMSE/PSNR-gated headroom stays 0 (reproduces findings.md 2026-06-03). All 7 lever families mapped+exhausted (steps FLAT, capacity +0.010, warm-start +0.039, SSIM-loss +0.073, SSIM-weight saturated, basis-scale FLAT, TV-reg FLAT); NONE moves hr off 0 -- the strongest (warm-start + SSIM-loss) got closest but stayed 7.3 dB short. The R2-G paper's regime is SPARSE-view CBCT (<=50 views) where FBP is weak; dense 128-view 2D CT is the wrong inductive bias. DECISION: empty-patch re-run of the iter-6 run-best config (warm-start + SSIM-loss@0.30, 1024G/130it) to confirm SSIM ~0.928 / hr=0 reproduces. BUDGET: ~660-1000s node-dependent, under the 1080 in-solver wall and 1800 SLURM wall, figure excluded. val_n=15 HELD CONSTANT. PREDICTION: SSIM ~0.928 (0.925-0.930), hr 0 -- faithful-but-regime-bounded negative result., gs_outer_wall_s=1080, gs_amp_init_max=0.05
